status: proposal-only reservation foundation; local cases passed, native/full-schema CI pending
semantics: Current authenticated actor must have explicit student edit access and not be partner-only; Owner management status provides no exception.
Server-derived canonical path binds actor/student/attempt ID and caller-claimed content/review-context hashes. These hashes do not certify file contents or consent.
Only the same actor with unchanged input and current access can recover a reserved receipt. Conflicting attempts return generic errors without exposing another receipt.

One unresolved reservation per student/claimed hash; identical content for different students stays separate. No automatic expiration or client mutations. Service role can inspect but has no direct mutation/creation RPC grant.
Student deletion is restricted while an unresolved attempt exists; this retention impact needs review with finalization/retention design.
not_implemented: Application integration and storage INSERT policy enforcement: current uploads and document registration can bypass this unused proposal ledger.
Object/version/scan/hash attestation, same-transaction finalization/reference locks, immutable remote-byte handling and time-of-check access graph races.
Terminal states, recovery/rate limits/quotas, trusted reconciliation, reference inventory, deletion claim/receipt and independent absence verification.
No cleanup worker, expiry policy, storage deletion, document deletion, AI enqueue or provider operation exists in this proposal.
initial_test_correction: The retention test initially expected SQLSTATE 23503; PGlite returns RESTRICT-specific 23001. It now accepts either integrity code and separately requires the exact student and attempt rows to remain.
